Remaining members must be in-use secondary; unknown critical secondary makes the set unsupported, while benign secondary extensions are preserved. No end/unused/primary records inside the set.

Preserve every raw record and unused unit; padding nonzero is advisory because zero initialization is a format recommendation. No trimming, NFC/case normalization, host path or uniqueness claim. Stored NameHash remains unverified until a qualified exact volume upcase mapping is supplied; matching hash alone never proves equal names.

compatibility: Known reserved bytes/bits are retained with advisory issues; they do not erase otherwise established entry association. Unknown critical entries remain unsupported. Unknown benign secondary bytes remain included in checksum and preserved. This is a private observation model, not a permissive mutation contract or persisted ABI.
errors: InvalidAPI/capacity/budget/overlong calls preserve output and input; no access before validating outer bounds.
